triggers.name: start_workflow
triggers.title: Start workflow
triggers.help: Use this to build a skill that can be called by Workato Agents, MCP clients, or other AI systems. Define what the skill needs to run, and what it sends back after it runs.

input.name: requires_user_confirmation
input.label: Require user confirmation before executing skill?
input.hint: If enabled, user will be prompted to confirm before executing this skill

input.name: description
input.label: When should this skill run?
input.hint: Describe this skill. Add any information that helps determine when to execute it.

input.name: parameters_schema_json
input.label: What inputs does this skill need to run?
input.hint: When this skill runs, the AI system either fills in these inputs automatically or asks the user for them. Use them as datapills in any action in this skill.

input.name: result_schema_json
input.label: What information does this skill send back?
input.hint: Define the output fields for this skill. After setting up all your actions, map the datapills to these fields in the Return step .

input.name: metadata_schema_json
input.label: Task metadata
input.hint: Only needed when this skill is used with the Assign Task action in the Genie connector. When a task is assigned to a genie, it can include metadata like a customer ID or ticket number. For this skill …

actions.name: workflow_return_result
actions.title: Return response
actions.help: The response that this skill returns. The output fields here are defined in the trigger step under 'What information does this skill send back?'
